# flux-system

This directory contains Flux's bootstrap resources and the reconciliation definitions for the
repository's workload areas.

## Resources

* [gotk-components.yaml](gotk-components.yaml) contains the Flux components generated by Flux.
  Do not edit this generated file by hand.
* [gotk-sync.yaml](gotk-sync.yaml) configures the Git source and root Flux reconciliation. It is
  generated by Flux; do not edit it by hand.
* [gotk-ordering.yaml](gotk-ordering.yaml) declares the Flux `Kustomization` resources that
  reconcile the workload directories and their dependencies.

Flux periodically fetches the configured Git source and reconciles the declared cluster state.
Changes to these resources can affect the entire cluster's reconciliation; review them carefully.
